tools.description: How booking works, the formats offered, and how fees are handled. Fees are provided on inquiry, tailored to format and location. Response within two business days.

tools.name: get_availability_guidance

tools.name: submit_speaking_inquiry
tools.description: Send a speaking inquiry to Thomas Anglero. Requires six fields: name, email, phone, company or organization, event date, and a free-text message. Fold every other detail into the message in natural language: what Thomas should speak about, event location, format (in person, virtual, or pre-recorded)

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "submit_speaking_inquiry" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Send a speaking inquiry to Thomas Anglero. Requires four fields only: name, email, event date, and a free-text message. Fold every other detail into the message in natural language: event location, format (in person, virtual, or pre-recorded), the topic or theme, expected audience size, the organisa" → after: "Send a speaking inquiry to Thomas Anglero. Requires six fields: name, email, phone, company or organization, event date, and a free-text message. Fold every other detail into the message in natural language: what Thomas should speak about, event location, format (in person, virtual, or pre-recorded)"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

detail: Description of "submit_advisory_inquiry" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Send a private advisory inquiry to Thomas Anglero on behalf of a CEO, Chair or board member who wants one-to-one advice on AI (The Reset), not a keynote. Before…

remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

remediation.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
remediation.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_advisory_info · Private data: submit_speaking_inquiry, get_advisory_info, submit_advisory_inquiry · Public sink: submit_speaking_inquiry, get_advisory_info, submit_advisory_inquiry · Destructive: get_booking_info, submit_speaking_inquiry, get_advisory_info, submit_advisory_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_advisory_info · Private data: submit_speaking_inquiry, get_advisory_info, submit_advisory_inquiry · Public sink: submit_speaking_inquiry, get_advisory_info, submit_advisory_inquiry · Destructive: get_booking_info, submit_speaking_inquiry, get_advisory_info, submit_advisory_inquiry

remediation.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
